about: The studio's keymap (README, The studio). Keys are in vim's notation: a character is itself, <C-r> is Ctrl+r, <S-Tab> Shift+Tab, <Space>, <Tab>, <Esc>, <Enter>, <Left> and <Right> name the keys; two characters together (gg) are pressed one after the other. A count typed first (5l) repeats a command that takes one. Each `ex` command is typed after `:`.
